4	-- Boldteq Unified Backend System — Global Core Schema
5	--
6	-- Creates the shared multi-app infrastructure that every Boldteq SaaS
7	-- (Rankora, CROBOT, future apps) sits on top of.
8	--
9	-- Key invariant: every app-specific row is tagged with (account_id, app_id).
10	-- RLS enforces that the caller is a member of the account AND that the
11	-- account has active access to the app via account_app_access.
12	--
13	-- Table graph:
14	--   apps <────────┐
15	--                 │
16	--   users ───> account_users <── accounts ──> account_app_access ──> apps
17	--                                   │                   │
18	--                                   │                   │
19	--                                   ├─> subscriptions ──┤

27	-- SECTION 1: Custom types

40	BEGIN

42	  RETURN NEW;
43	END;
44	$$;

121	-- SECTION 6: account_users — roster with roles

142	-- SECTION 7: plans — per-app pricing + limits
143	-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
144	
145	CREATE TABLE plans (
146	  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
147	  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

149	  name         text        NOT NULL,
150	  description  text,
151	  billing_type text        NOT NULL
152	                           CHECK (billing_type IN ('free', 'subscription', 'one_time')),
153	  price_cents  integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
154	  currency     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
155	  interval     text        CHECK (interval IN ('month', 'year', NULL)),
156	  limits_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
157	  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'

159	  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
160	  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
161	  UNIQUE (app_id, slug)
162	);
163	
164	CREATE INDEX idx_plans_app ON plans(app_id);
165	
166	CREATE TRIGGER plans_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON plans
167	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
168	
169	COMMENT ON TABLE plans IS
170	  'Per-app plan catalog. limits_json shape is app-specific (e.g. {"max_jobs": 10}).';
171	
172	
173	-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
174	-- SECTION 8: account_app_access — which accounts have access to which apps
175	-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
176	-- The central entitlement table. An account can only use an app if it
177	-- has an active row here. Every RLS policy on app-specific tables
178	-- references this via has_app_access().
179	
180	CREATE TABLE account_app_access (
181	  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
182	  account_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
183	  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
184	  plan_id      uuid        REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
185	  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
186	                           CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'cancelled')),
187	  activated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
188	  expires_at   timestamptz,
189	  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
190	  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
191	  UNIQUE (account_id, app_id)
192	);
193	
194	CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_account ON account_app_access(account_id);
195	CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_app ON account_app_access(app_id);

197	CREATE TRIGGER account_app_access_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON account_app_access
198	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
199	
200	COMMENT ON TABLE account_app_access IS

292	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_app_id(p_slug text)
293	RETURNS uuid
294	LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
295	  SELECT id FROM apps WHERE slug = p_slug AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1;
296	$$;
297	
298	COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_app_id(text) IS
299	  'Resolves an app slug (e.g. ''rankora'') to its UUID. Used in RLS policies and edge functions.';
300	
301	
302	-- get_user_accounts: returns all accounts a user belongs to
303	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_accounts(p_user_id uuid)
304	RETURNS TABLE (account_id uuid, role account_role)
305	LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
306	  SELECT account_id, role FROM account_users WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
307	$$;
308	
309	
310	-- is_account_member: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the account
311	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_member(p_account_id uuid)
312	RETURNS boolean
313	LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
314	  SELECT EXISTS (
315	    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
316	    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
317	      AND user_id = auth.uid()
318	  );
319	$$;
320	
321	COMMENT ON FUNCTION is_account_member(uuid) IS
322	  'RLS helper: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the given account.';
323	
324	
325	-- is_account_admin: true if the current auth.uid() is owner or admin
326	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_admin(p_account_id uuid)
327	RETURNS boolean
328	LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
329	  SELECT EXISTS (
330	    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
331	    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
332	      AND user_id = auth.uid()
333	      AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
334	  );
335	$$;
336	
337	
338	-- has_app_access: true if the account has active access to the app
339	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_app_access(p_account_id uuid, p_app_id uuid)
340	RETURNS boolean
341	LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
342	  SELECT EXISTS (
343	    SELECT 1 FROM account_app_access
344	    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
345	      AND app_id = p_app_id
346	      AND status = 'active'
347	      AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
348	  );
349	$$;
350	
351	COMMENT ON FUNCTION has_app_access(uuid, uuid) IS
352	  'RLS helper: true if the account has an active entitlement for the app.';
353	
354	
355	-- get_primary_account: returns the caller's first (owned or member) account.
356	-- Used by edge functions when no explicit account_id is provided.
357	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_primary_account(p_user_id uuid)
358	RETURNS uuid
359	LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
360	  SELECT au.account_id
361	  FROM account_users au
362	  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = au.account_id
363	  WHERE au.user_id = p_user_id
364	    AND a.status = 'active'
365	  ORDER BY
366	    CASE au.role
367	      WHEN 'owner' THEN 1
368	      WHEN 'admin' THEN 2
369	      WHEN 'member' THEN 3
370	      WHEN 'viewer' THEN 4
371	    END,
372	    au.created_at ASC
373	  LIMIT 1;
374	$$;
